messages:
maria_sales: Heads-up — Acme POC kickoff tomorrow. Need to lock scope, success criteria, timeline, and on-call owners. They require SSO + data residency checks. @jamal_se can you confirm eval prompts and perf targets? cc @olivia_eng for infra. :eyes:
jamal_se: On it. Proposed success criteria: 1) 95th perc latency < 250ms under their expected concurrency, 2) task-level accuracy (F1) >= 0.82 on holdout, 3) cost per 1k tokens < $1.50. Need sample prompts + labeled eval set. Do they have a gold set or do we synthesize?
maria_sales: They have ~2k labeled QA pairs and ~8k raw logs. Plan: use 2k labeled for eval, 1k holdout, and sample ~2k prompts from logs for tuning. Can we support SAML SSO + audit logs for hosted?
olivia_eng: SAML + audit logs are doable but for strict data isolation we should recommend Dedicated capacity (hosted dedicated pool) or Private. Dedicated pool requires ~2 SE days to provision IP allowlist + certs. Proposed milestones below.
jamal_se: Draft timeline:
```
Week 0 (prep): security questionnaire + creds + eval data ingest
Week 1: infra provision + baseline runs (latency/cost)
Week 2: prompt tuning, quantization profile tests, reranker/beam tweaks
Week 3: final eval, customer demo, handoff + runbook
```
jamal_se: For baseline scale estimate: target 1k qps burst, steady 100 qps. I think 2 x A10-ish GPU dedicated pool should hit latency target. I'll provide config + cost estimate.
ben_finance: Pricing note: we can offer either a 50% hosted usage credit up to $5k for POC, or a Dedicated trial with $7k credit (covers initial reserved pool). If customer wants Private/on-prem we need SOW + minimum commitment. Also flag: dedicated/provisioning work needs billing approval if > 40h infra.
maria_sales: Customer prefers hosted but insists on data isolation. Suggest hosted + dedicated pool + IP allowlist. Jamal — confirm burst sizing and whether we can scrub logs after the run to satisfy data residency.
jamal_se: Confirmed: hosted dedicated pool + IP allowlist supports their needs. We can enable ephemeral storage and automatic log purge; will require KMS key handling for audit logs. Security will need to sign off.
security_bot: Security check: SAML SSO supported. Q12 on the questionnaire (KMS/HSM) requires ops sign-off; timeline 72h after PO. Need completed sec questionnaire (link: https://redwood/sq/ACME-2026). Also require contact for SOC2 artifacts.
maria_sales: Action items:
- jamal_se -> deliver eval prompt set + baseline config by EOD today
- olivia_eng -> infra effort estimate & SE availability calendar by EOD today
- ben_finance -> POC pricing options + SOW template by EOD
I'll schedule kickoff call for tomorrow 11:00 PT and invite customer + our SEs. :calendar:
olivia_eng: Ack — I'll block 2 days this week for provisioning and 1 day for cutover during week1. Will attach calendar invite.
ben_finance: I'll prep 2 options in the SOW: (A) hosted-dedicated trial w/ credits, (B) private eval w/ SOW minimums. Sending draft in thread.
maria_sales: Noted. Small blocker — customer legal is asking about data deletion SLA. Can we commit to 30-day purge after POC?
jamal_se: 30-day purge yes, we can do immediate purge on request but need a signed PO and change to retention policy. I'll note this in runbook.
ben_finance: Legal & Finance need a short addendum for deletion & KMS handling. I'll loop in legal after SOW draft.
security_bot: Added checklist: SAML config, KMS flow, audit log retention, SOC2 artifacts. All teams please confirm completion in this thread.
maria_sales: Great. Quick reactions: :thumbsup: from me. Everyone, please post deliverables here as you complete them so I can close the POC playbook. Thanks all.
